gloss: to stream; to distribute; to deliver content

definitions.gloss: to distribute; to deliver (information, news, content)
definitions.explanation: To send out or distribute content such as news, emails, or notifications to recipients.
To stream or broadcast content live or on-demand over the internet, including video, music, and live streams.

notes:
A compound of {配|はい} (distribute) and {信|しん} (message, information). Originally used for distributing news and information, it has become strongly associated with online streaming and content delivery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{動画|どうが}{配信|はいしん}→動画配信：19012_dougahaishin⟧: video streaming/distribution
- ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦{配信|はいしん}→配信：04898_haishin⟧: music streaming/distribution
- ⟦{生|なま}{配信|はいしん}→生配信：05399_namahaishin⟧: live streaming
- ⟦{配信|はいしん}→配信：04898_haishin⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧: streaming/distribution service
- ⟦{配信|はいしん}{者|しゃ}→配信者：16573_haishinsha⟧: streamer, content distributor
- ⟦{配信|はいしん}→配信：04898_haishin⟧⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧: start of distribution/streaming

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{放送|ほうそう}する→放送する：01852_housousuru⟧: to broadcast — traditional TV/radio broadcasting
- ⟦{配信|はいしん}→配信：04898_haishin⟧ is specifically for internet-based distribution and streaming, while ⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧ covers traditional broadcast media
